summary.text: Tom Dent is a Republican member of the Washington House of Representatives for District 13-Position 1, in office since January 12, 2015, and he is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Juan Garcia.
A pilot and the founder of Tom Dent Aviation, he ranches bison and grows hay near Moses Lake.

paragraphs.text: Dent has been a Columbia Basin resident most of his life, according to his House Republican biography, and became a professional pilot in 1976.

He soon founded Tom Dent Aviation, which offered aerial application, pilot service and flight instruction to area agriculture and industry, and he lives on the Flying T Ranch northeast of Moses Lake, where he raises bison and produces hay.
Wikipedia adds that he is a former chairman of the Grant County Republican Party.
Dent was elected in 2014 to the seat vacated by Judy Warnick, who left to run for the state Senate, and he was sworn in in 2015.
His biography says he serves on the Early Learning and Human Services and Transportation committees and is ranking member of the Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee.

It lists his priorities as wildfire prevention and forest health, agriculture issues including trade and water resource management, aviation infrastructure and workforce training, and mental health reform.
